notes.title: Exciting news from the TMG team!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Explorers,[/h1][p][/p][h3]We have exciting news![/h3][p]Both [i]We Were Here[/i] and [i]We Were Here Too[/i] have received brand-new updates! These patches focus on quality-of-life improvements, making it easier and smoother than ever to step back into the cold, mysterious halls where your journey began. From technical fixes to subtle polish, these updates breathe fresh life into the first two games of the series. Perfect if you’ve been thinking of revisiting the adventure or introducing a new partner to where it all started. [/p][p][/p][h3]But that’s not all… [/h3][p]We’re thrilled to announce that both [i]We Were Here[/i] and [i]We Were Here Too[/i] are now available on Nintendo Switch! 🎉 This marks a whole new way to explore the Antarctic mysteries with your partner, no matter where your adventures take you. [/p][previewyoutube="MUn4X9HajDI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]And we’re not stopping there:[/b] [i]We Were Here Together[/i] is also on the way for Switch, planned to release on [b]October 9th.[/b] Alongside this, it will receive its very own quality-of-life update, bringing the same improvements that our earlier entries just received. [/p][p][/p][h3]For our Explorers attending the Tokyo Game Show next week: come find us! [/h3][p]We’ll be at the show with We Were Here goodies, friendly faces from the dev team, and plenty to chat about regarding the past, present, and future of the series. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/5c296fc7e04e817d500e2702b6d3e4da13fc00fa.png"][/img][/p][h3]Thank you, Explorers, for all your support and enthusiasm! [/h3][p]It’s because of you that the We Were Here journey continues to grow across more platforms and adventures. Whether you’re returning to the frozen halls or stepping into them for the first time, remember: the only way out… is together. [/p][p][/p][h3]— Total Mayhem Games[/h3]

notes.title: The We Were Here series is coming to Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Explorers,[/h2][p][/p][p]Some of you know these halls all too well. You’ve wandered the frozen corridors of Castle Rock, walkie-talkie in hand, voice cracking through the static. You’ve solved puzzles, shouted directions, cracked codes, and yes, maybe left your partner behind once or twice. It happens.[/p][p]For years, the [i]We Were Here[/i] series has tested friendships on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox. Now, it’s time for a new expedition.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]We’re super excited to announce that [i]We Were Here[/i], [i]We Were Here Too[/i], and [i]We Were Here Together[/i] are coming to Nintendo Switch![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="TF6n0lMsYv0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Your favourite co-op adventure is going handheld (or docked, if you want to see your friend betray you on the big screen).[/p][p]To play on Switch, you’ll need two things: a Nintendo Switch Online Membership and an external microphone. The trilogy will also be backwards compatible with the Switch 2, so whether you’re playing on shiny new hardware or your trusty old console, you can still team up together. As always, you and your friend will both need a separate copy of the game you want to play.

If you're new here, [i]We Were Here[/i] games are all about two players, trapped apart in a forgotten place, trying to escape through communication alone. You won’t see each other, and can only talk to each other over your walkie-talkies. Every puzzle you solve depends on how well you work together.[/p][p]If you’re a weathered Explorer, this is your chance to bring a new partner to Castle Rock. That friend who only games on Switch? Time to hand them a walkie-talkie and hope they’re better at reading runes than you were.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you're playing curled up in a blanket fort or squeezed into a train seat, remember:[/p][p]You’re never truly alone…[/p][p][/p][h3]See you on the other end of the walkie-talkie,
[b]Total Mayhem Games[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Our Great Studio Migration!
notes.content:
[i]2024 was a year in which our mighty developers haven’t been sitting still—quite the opposite. After months of exploring all the crooks and crannies of the vast terrain of Rotterdam, we have secured a beautiful and spacious new base in the booming city center![/i]

[h2]We are growing![/h2]

Over the past year, our numbers have swelled, welcoming a host of talented and inspiring individuals to the fold. This is great news, but it did come with a downside. Our once-spacious studio at Schiehavenkade began to feel... rather snug. Long queues for the microwaves during feeding hours, overheated meeting rooms, and desks encroaching dangerously close to the entrance—a sure sign it was time to seek new territory. The best part: we have [url=https://youtu.be/oC5Hpgu9VVI]documented[/url] the entire move!

[previewyoutube=oC5Hpgu9VVI;full][/previewyoutube]

We hold beautiful memories of the games we created in our old studio and can’t wait to see what magic unfolds in our new home.

Curious to see where all the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/WWHfranchise]We Were Here games[/url] were made? Find them all in this map, including our dev's favourite hotspots!

notes.title: Happy frenniversary! 🎉
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Explorers,[/h1]

[h2]Happy Frenniversary! 🎉[/h2]

It’s been one whole year since we launched We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip, and what an incredible year it’s been! Let’s take a trip down memory lane and revisit the exciting moments from the reveal of this special game.

[h2]Crafting a Secret[/h2]

After the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever/]We Were Here Forever[/url] in 2022, our team started plotting the next chapter in the We Were Here series. With Forever being our longest and most intricate adventure, packed with puzzles, mysteries, and expansive locations, we knew we wanted to offer something a little different next. This time, we aimed for something short, sweet, and perfect for explorers who want a bite-sized co-op experience.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2296990/We_Were_Here_Expeditions_The_FriendShip/]We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip[/url] was born—a game designed to be fun, challenging, and most of all, an absolute blast to play with your friends, whether they’re seasoned fans of the We Were Here series or joining us for the first time.

[h2]The Big Reveal at WASD x IGN 🎮[/h2]

Now, we couldn’t just launch The FriendShip like any ordinary game. No, we wanted to do something BIG—something that would surprise and delight our amazing community! So, we decided to go full stealth mode, keeping the entire game a secret until its grand reveal at WASD x IGN. And what’s better than a surprise? A free surprise! 🎁 We dropped the game for free for the first month, allowing millions of you to hop aboard and set sail on this new co-op adventure.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/2b7241314815735337511a526af068ba87da39bd.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/2b7241314815735337511a526af068ba87da39bd.jpg[/img][/url]

The response was overwhelming! Over 6 million explorers claimed The FriendShip, joining our ever-growing We Were Here family. 💖

[h2]Celebrating Friendship 🫶[/h2]

At Total Mayhem Games, friendship is the heart and soul of everything we create. It’s the thread that ties all our games together, and it’s the bond we share with you, our amazing explorers. We simply couldn’t have reached this point without your endless love and support.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/e0b56b7e1c49f6f6b1cd9835a6031e31c31463c1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/e0b56b7e1c49f6f6b1cd9835a6031e31c31463c1.png[/img][/url]

And guess what? There’s more on the horizon! We've got some exciting stuff coming up. So stay tuned, and always remember: “There are good ships, and wood ships, ships that sail the sea. But the best ships are friendships, and may they always be!”

Here’s to many more adventures together!

[h3]All the best,
Total Mayhem Games[/h3]

notes.title: We Were Here Together has been released!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=XhE5mPCHdY4;full][/previewyoutube]
The sequel to [i]We Were Here Too[/i] is out now on Steam! Get it for $12.99 / €12.99. There is a launch discount of 5%, and all of you who own [i]We Were Here Too[/i] will get a 10% discount. The third game in the [i]We Were Here[/i] series features new gameplay mechanics, locations, and puzzles. In response to your requests, there is more emphasis on story than ever before, and several large environments to explore and solve puzzles within.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/c3ea4f6faa8cb94657c38b8ad5ff709cf69c1024.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/c3ea4f6faa8cb94657c38b8ad5ff709cf69c1024.png[/img][/url]
[i]Your adventure will start out at the base camp...[/i]

What’s new?
[list][*]Even closer coop – you won’t always be split up from your partner this time. Explore together, try both sides of a puzzle for a different perspective, it’s up to you! Just don’t get too comfortable - Castle Rock has some tricks waiting for you…
[*]The great outdoors – puzzle outside Castle Rock for the first time, from the deceptively cosy expedition base camp through imposing sub-zero valleys to breath-taking frozen caves.
[*]Gadgets won’t save you - but they might help! Figure out how to use new equipment and gather an inventory of curious items to solve puzzles and progress towards the fateful finale in [i]We Were Here Together[/i].
[*]You aren’t alone in Castle Rock – and this time you get to meet a fellow explorer who is trapped inside. Could they know a way out… and can you trust them?[/list] 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/c45e7bb15ccd5d661462a012e98b780924805539.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/c45e7bb15ccd5d661462a012e98b780924805539.png[/img][/url]
[i]You will travel through the icy wastes...[/i]

At the start of the game, you and your partner will be able to walk around together, looking for clues and solving puzzles. There's an epic journey ahead of you, from the warmth of the base camp through the Antarctic wastes to the sinister Castle Rock. Inside, you'll get split up.

From then on, you and your partner will really have to test your communication skills to their limits, sharing your asymmetric perspectives to figure out puzzles together.  Keep your eyes open, keep talking, and you might just make it out in one piece.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/67daf72bbd9e49217cf26b969f50695c40c28ede.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/67daf72bbd9e49217cf26b969f50695c40c28ede.png[/img][/url]
[i]...and who knows where you'll end up?[/i]

For anyone who doesn’t have the complete collection yet, check out the We Were Here Series Bundle! It does what it says on the can, with all three games, two supporter editions, and every soundtrack in one tidy collection. That’s right, two supporter editions: the [i]We Were Here Together[/i] Supporter Edition contains a special walkie-talkie skin, beautiful artworks designed specially for desktop or phone backgrounds, and almost an hour of music!

More than 2,000,000 players on Steam have enjoyed [i]We Were Here[/i] and [i]We Were Here Too[/i] since their releases. We can't wait to see what people make of the latest game!

[h1]We hope you'll join us in meeting up [i]together[/i] for the third entry – We Were Here Together![/h1]

notes.title: On the lookout for new puzzle testers for We Were Here Together!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/89c173ef8ef232a6f574ccf0eaba089300cf4062.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/89c173ef8ef232a6f574ccf0eaba089300cf4062.png[/img][/url]
Hello Antarctic explorers! We are looking for more people to give feedback on our early versions of new puzzles for the next game in the series: We Were Here Together. The testing will be done between April 5th and May 3rd. If you think that you and a friend might be up for it, read on!

[h1]How will it work?[/h1]
We will release a new puzzle every Friday. The first puzzle will be released on the 5th of April at 19:00. The last puzzle will be released on the 3rd of May. Puzzles are fully playable for two people, but not yet polished to the high standard you can expect from us in the final release. When you are selected, we will assign you a single puzzle / area to play in a particular week, based on when you’re available. More time may be granted for testing if we decide a puzzle could benefit from additional testing and feedback.

On top of having the opportunity to see new puzzles develop, testers will get credited in the game with their Steam profile name.The first 100 applicants who fit our requirements will be accepted into the testing program. If you aren’t one of the first 100, don't feel disappointed yet as we might still ask you to join testing in the future if it turns out that we need additional testers.

[h1]How can I join?[/h1]
There has been a lot of interest in testing the game, and therefore we're closing applications for now. Thanks to everyone who has mailed us and you will all receive an answer, but it might take a bit longer than expected due to the volume of requests. Thanks for your patience!

Include the following:
[*]Your Steam profile name.
[*]Your partner’s Steam profile name.
[*]A short explanation of why you two want to join the testing and why you think you could be helpful.
[*]Which weeks (running from Friday to Thursday) you and your partner are available for testing. 
[/list]
Note that, depending on the test, you will spend between 30 minutes and two hours on testing.
After you submit your email we’ll get back to you with more information. You and your partner don’t both need to submit an email, one between you is enough!

Please note that there are certain requirements that will be used to determine who will be selected for puzzle testing.
Requirements:
[*]You have to be able to play the game in at least one of the weeks within the given timeframe.
[*]You have played We Were Here (Too) for at least an hour.
[*]Your Steam profile level is at least level 4.
[*]Your Steam profile is visible to us, so we can check these requirements.
[*]You have to be able to record both video and the audio of your playing session, and send them to us.
[*]You are able to give written feedback to us about your experience playing an early puzzle.
[*] You can communicate with us via our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/CPaReE3]Discord[/url].
[/list]
You will also be asked to agree to the following NDA:

[b]Non-Disclosure Agreement[/b]
In taking part in this early testing, you agree not to share information, screenshots, or video relating to the puzzles you experience. It goes without saying that the magic of the game is figuring out the puzzles with a friend, so we need to control what information is released before the game comes out. We hope you understand and appreciate your cooperation!

Our current testers have been exceptional with their comments and suggestions, and we’re hugely grateful. If you’d like to join them, we look forward to hearing from you!

[/list]

[/list]

[b]Windows: [/b]%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Total Mayhem Games\We Were Here Too\Config
[b]OSX: [/b]~/Library/Application Support/Total Mayhem Games/We Were Here Too/Config
[b]Linux: [/b]$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/unity3d/Total Mayhem Games/We Were Here Too/Config
Expect the old folder/file to be removed in a future update.

We've been trying to reproduce the issue on our systems without luck, however we have made some changes to the code based on the videos and reports we have collected on the forums. Please let us know if the issue has been resolved.

If you are still experiencing any issues i encourage you to join the discussions here on steam!

Thanks again for all of your feedback.
